limitations.note: The rewrite bypassed the registered light-output stage and reset directly to red, changing startup and transition timing instead of restoring the one-cycle delay that lets the original counter detect light changes.
The test encoded the rewrite’s immediate-red reset and direct transition timing, so it passed without checking the original design’s all-off reset and registered output sequence.
